name: run.iko/publish
title: Iko Run
description: Publish self-contained HTML to a public iko.run subdomain without signup.

tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Publish self-contained HTML at a public iko.run URL only when the user wants it public. Share the URL and store the edit key privately.

html.description: HTML source up to 2,000,000 UTF-8 bytes, with CSS and JavaScript inline.

slug.description: Optional subdomain. Omit for a generated name.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional page expiry. Omit for a page with no fixed expiry.

idempotency_key.description: Private random version 4 UUID. Reuse for an exact retry.
